meta.name: linkedin-comment-drafter
meta.description: Draft a LinkedIn comment on someone else's post from its URL, or reshare (repost) it to your feed with optional commentary. Use when the user pastes a post URL and asks to comment, engage, be first commenter, or repost with their thoughts. Produces 1-3 variants in the user's voice, picks a reaction, and publishes via Publora on approval. Not for replying to existing comments (use linkedin-reply-handler).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 粘贴帖子链接,生成你口吻的评论并发布或转发
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常在 LinkedIn 参与讨论,想快速写出得体评论并转发
copy.tagline_en: Paste a post link to get comment drafts in your voice, then publish or reshare
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engage on LinkedIn often and want quick, on-brand comment drafts

howto.what: 粘贴 LinkedIn 帖子链接后,它会抓取帖子正文和已有评论,产出 1-3 条你口吻的评论草稿(每条 200-350 字符,附反应类型和所用模板),经你确认后通过 Publora 发布。
howto.when: 当你粘贴 LinkedIn 帖子链接并说「评论这条」「互动一下」等,或想抢占病毒帖的前三评论位时触发。

say.text: 用 T2 模板,回答作者结尾提的那个问题
这条评论通过 Publora 发布
say.note: 你确认后才会真正发布

howto.what_en: After you paste a LinkedIn post URL, it fetches the post body and existing comments, drafts 1-3 comment variants in your voice (200-350 chars each) with a reaction type, and publishes via Publora once you approve.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste a LinkedIn post URL and ask to comment, engage, or grab an early comment slot, or to repost with your thoughts.

say_en.note: Fetches the post, then shows 1-3 drafts

say_en.text: Use the T2 template and answer the author's closing question
